Hildegard 0.1.6 is a pre-alpha. It brings Hildegard into your AI apps as the way they reach your own computers, with
its craft skills and a loop that keeps improving a piece until it passes.

## Install

- **macOS and Linux:** `curl -fsSL https://dbaney.com/hildegard/install.sh | sh`
- **Windows (PowerShell):** `irm https://dbaney.com/hildegard/install.ps1 | iex`
- **Desktop app:** pick your system's download below, or from [dbaney.com/hildegard](https://dbaney.com/hildegard/).

Installed already? Hildegard updates itself, or run `hildegard update`.

## New

- **A Claude Code plugin.** `/plugin marketplace add baney75/hildegard`, then `/plugin install hildegard@hildegard`:
  Hildegard's tools on your GPUs and every skill, in two commands. If Hildegard isn't installed yet, the plugin tells
  Claude how to install it.
- **Every chatbot's steps** in [docs/chatbots.md](https://github.com/baney75/hildegard/blob/main/docs/chatbots.md):
  the Claude app, claude.ai and Cowork, ChatGPT, Grok and Grok Bot. Below are `hildegard.plugin` (skills for the
  Claude app and Cowork) and a `skill-*.zip` for each skill (claude.ai and ChatGPT uploads).
- **Skills over MCP.** Any app linked to Hildegard can read its skills with `list_skills` and `read_skill`, and apps
  that list MCP prompts show each skill as one.
- **The hildegard skill:** the midwife's method for serious creative work in any form, from a short interview and real
  research to drafts, contact sheets, blind critique and checks.
- **3D models.** The **hildegard-3d** skill builds models in code (`mesh_kit.py`), and Hildegard checks each one:
  watertight, manifold, winding, volume, loose bodies, debris and size, and for prints units, bed, base, overhang and
  balance, with a sheet of eight views, a top or bottom view and silhouettes.
- **The loop.** `loop_start`, `loop_submit`, `loop_critique` and `loop_finish` take a 3D model, still, take or sound
  through generate, render, critique, refine. Hildegard takes the next round only after every question about the
  last one is answered with what the sheet shows, and keeps every round.
- **A coding agent can run a whole loop** for you: `hildegard loop run codex "a heron finial, 120 mm, for my printer"
  --kind model --print`. It runs within each provider's terms: started by you, on a plan in its own app, or on your
  API key.

## Known limits

- Macs don't render on their own GPU yet. Pair a Mac with a computer that has an NVIDIA or AMD GPU
  (`hildegard choir join`).
- The Windows and macOS apps aren't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen and macOS Gatekeeper ask you to confirm the first launch.
- claude.ai, ChatGPT, Grok and Grok Bot reach Hildegard only at a public link (`hildegard host --funnel`). Hildegard
  Link, the encrypted relay that needs no Tailscale, is coming soon.
- 3D models are checked from GLB, glTF, STL, OBJ and PLY with embedded data; Draco-compressed GLB isn't read yet.
- LTX models follow Lightricks' license: free under $10M yearly revenue, and not for products that compete with
  Lightricks. Wan 2.2 is Apache-2.0.
